name: whitebackground
description: Create a pure #FFFFFF PNG canvas, or open WhiteBackground’s free local photo editor for white backgrounds, transparent cutouts, PNG-to-white, square padding, Shopify sizing or local enlargement. Photos are chosen in the official editor; this plugin does not upload them or spend credits. No WhiteBackground account or API key.

description_i18n.en: Create a pure #FFFFFF PNG canvas, or open WhiteBackground’s free local photo editor for white backgrounds, transparent cutouts, PNG-to-white, square padding, Shopify sizing or local enlargement. Photos are chosen in the official editor; this plugin does not upload them or spend credits. No WhiteBackground account or API key.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 生成纯白 #FFFFFF 的 PNG 画布，或打开 WhiteBackground 免费本机编辑器：白底图、透明抠图、透明 PNG 铺白底、不裁切的正方形、Shopify 尺寸、本地放大。照片由你在官方编辑器里选择，本插件不会上传，也不会消耗积分。无需 WhiteBackground 账号或 API 密钥。
